description: This file defines the ExternalOAuthConnection class, which extends the Basic class to manage OAuth connection records, enforce access controls, and handle authentication-related operations within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, permission checking, and logging activities related to OAuth connections.

classes.name: ExternalOAuthConnection
classes.description: Represents an OAuth connection entity with methods to handle access restrictions, retrieval, persistence, and logging related to OAuth connections in SuiteCRM.

methods.description: Retrieves a record by ID with access validation.

methods.description: Saves the current record after checking access permissions.

methods.name: hasAccessToPersonalAccount
methods.description: Determines if the current user has access to a personal OAuth account.

methods.name: logPersonalAccountAccessDenied
methods.description: Logs an access denial message for personal account operations.
